rongmei.title: Sam thai e thei tingkao thu tei

lines: 1. Samthai e thei tingkao thu tei,
Muang le ganchuang na ding khou ,
Samthai e tei tingkao ram khou,
Salem ram khou sam tang ni,
Kailuang guai kachaek dui ruina
Luang lik lou kabam thui khou,
Nang ringh mei riu rui gaan likge,
Namthan dai gaimei khou tei.
Ai rui ning e ting saeng namdaih,
Bumaeng thanmei nun bam tei,
Katik gun rui mundui kumna,
Ringhmei dui tei luang bam e. 2
2. Hei khou tei bam mei nun guai rui,
Thei mei kandi lou duna,
Kaniu Ravguangc ram gaimei khou,
Kaniu mikdui keilak khe,
Gun kum ma phuan lou ngam puni,
Kandih lun phung dat lakhe,
Rianramei guai khaeng dat lak khe,
Jisu le bam cham pukhou.
3. Ting saeng zaeng nzian mei nun le,
Heiram gai khou lung cham ni,
Kandih khou bampui ganv kum na,
Alung hei geic dat lak khe,
Kandi khou rian rana bam mei,
Chun si zaeng si kapum na,
Tingkao namdai guang tang pukhou,
Nai lak khe kapum ma tei.
